# Christian Culture Global
> International Christian music, 24/7 Bible radio, worship music releases, and scripture-grounded articles.

Website: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/
Publisher: Christian Culture — https://polskieradio.cc
Founders: Cezary Rogowski (Nazir) & Wioletta Rogowska

## 24/7 Global Audio & Video Streams
- **Radio Global (English)**: https://polskieradio.cc — 24/7 contemporary worship, preaching, biblical analysis in English.
- **Global Bible Radio (English)**: https://polskieradio.cc — 24/7 non-stop English Holy Scripture narration.
- **Bible Audio Global Player**: https://polskieradio.cc/bibleaudio-global.html
- **CCTV24 Worship TV Global**: https://polskieradio.cc/cctv24-global.html

## Featured Artists & Music Releases
- **Featured Artist**: JJ Beauvais — *Now Is The Time*; *Written In Heaven (Live)*
- **YouTube & Playlists**: https://youtube.com/@personalitypluscc
- **Biblical Worship (Cała Biblia w Muzyce)**: https://polskieradio.cc/BiblijneUwielbienie

## Published English Articles & Thought Leadership
1. **Biblical Worship — Sing the Entire Word of God!**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/biblical-worship-sing-the-word-of-god/
   - Musical journey through 66 books and 1,189 chapters of Scripture with synchronized karaoke.
2. **The Power of Worship Music**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/the-power-of-worship-music/
   - How biblical praise renews hearts and focuses thoughts on Christ.
3. **How the Psalms Still Speak Today**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/how-the-psalms-still-speak-today/
   - The ancient prayer book of Israel as a timeless guide for modern faith, lament, and adoration.
4. **JJ Beauvais — Two Songs of Hope**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/jj-beauvais-two-songs-of-hope/
   - In-depth look at *Now Is The Time* and *Written In Heaven (Live)*.
5. **Music and Scripture — A Deeper Connection**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/music-and-scripture-deeper-connection/
   - Exploring melodies that internalize God's Word in daily spiritual life.
6. **Global Gospel — Christian Music Around the World**: https://polskieradio.cc/Global/articles/global-gospel-christian-music-around-the-world/
   - Multilingual unity in Christ across continents and cultures (Revelation 7:9).

## Editorial Policy & Machine Readability
- All Scripture quotations cite canonical Protestant translations (e.g., King James, English Standard Version / UBG for Polish cross-references).
- Machine-friendly sitemap: https://polskieradio.cc/sitemaps/en.xml
- Disallow private endpoints: `/admin/`, `/mission-control/`, `/mess`.
